name: Global Matrix Identity
description: I reformulate the local binary inequality constraints into a single global matrix equation (M = X^T A X). The main diagonal of this matrix counts the number of monochromatic edges for each color. By requiring the diagonal to be all zeros, the mathematical condition remains exactly equivalent to 3-coloring, but models that fail to symbolically deduce this equivalence will attempt to evaluate the matrix globally at the leaves of a backtracking search, resulting in a Time Limit Exceeded error for n=40.
